description: This is the main activity class for an Android Wearable app that handles voice recording, playback, and music playback within a user interface, managing permissions, media resources, and UI states.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Android activity managing voice recording, playback, and music playback UI and logic.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, UI, and permissions.

methods.name: onUIStateChanged
methods.description: Handles UI state changes to manage recording, playback, and music.

methods.name: stopMusic
methods.description: Stops the MP3 playback and releases resources.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles the result of permission requests.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Begins app operation, sets up UI and recorder.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Lifecycle method, initiates permission check or shows info on unsupported devices.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Lifecycle cleanup, releases media and recorder resources.

methods.name: onPlaybackStopped
methods.description: Callback for voice playback stop event.

methods.name: speakerIsSupported
methods.description: Detects if the device has a supported built-in speaker.
